title: hieracium sabaudum subsp. maranzae
intro: Hieracium sabaudum subsp. maranzae, commonly known as the Sardinian Hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium sabaudum subsp. maranzae include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
